# CDN20
> CDN20 provides CDN, cloud security, and edge delivery services for websites, applications, and media.

CDN20 offers content delivery, DDoS protection, WAF, DNS, SSL, and media acceleration services, with documentation and product information for configuring and operating its platform.

## Main
- [Home](https://www.cdn20.com/): Overview of CDN20’s edge delivery, security, and acceleration platform.
- [Products](https://www.cdn20.com/products/): Entry point for CDN20 product categories and service capabilities.
- [Solutions](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/): Use-case and industry-focused solution overviews for CDN20 services.
- [Pricing](https://www.cdn20.com/pricing/): Commercial plans and service pricing information.
- [Contact](https://www.cdn20.com/contact-us/): Contact page for sales, support, and general inquiries.
- [About](https://www.cdn20.com/about-us/): Company background and organizational information.

## Products
- [CDN](https://www.cdn20.com/products/cdn/): Content delivery network service for accelerating static and dynamic web content.
- [Cloud Security](https://www.cdn20.com/products/cloud-security/): Security services for protecting applications and infrastructure at the edge.
- [DDoS Protection](https://www.cdn20.com/products/ddos-protection/): Network and application-layer DDoS mitigation capabilities.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.cdn20.com/products/web-application-firewall/): WAF features for filtering malicious HTTP and HTTPS traffic.
- [DNS](https://www.cdn20.com/products/dns/): Managed DNS service for resilient and performant domain resolution.
- [Media Delivery](https://www.cdn20.com/products/media-delivery/): Video and media acceleration services for streaming and large asset delivery.

## Solutions
- [Website Acceleration](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/website-acceleration/): Improve page load performance and global content delivery.
- [Application Security](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/application-security/): Protect web applications from attacks and abusive traffic.
- [Video Streaming](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/video-streaming/): Optimize live and on-demand media delivery workflows.
- [Gaming](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/gaming/): Low-latency delivery and protection for gaming platforms.
- [E-commerce](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/e-commerce/): Performance and security solutions for online storefronts.
- [Enterprise](https://www.cdn20.com/solutions/enterprise/): Scalable edge and security services for enterprise deployments.

- [CDN Documentation](https://docs.cdn20.com/cdn/): Product documentation for CDN configuration and delivery behavior.
- [Security Documentation](https://docs.cdn20.com/security/): Guides for security features, policies, and protections.
- [DNS Documentation](https://docs.cdn20.com/dns/): Managed DNS setup and operational documentation.
- [SSL Documentation](https://docs.cdn20.com/ssl/): Certificate provisioning and HTTPS configuration guidance.

## API & Developer
- [API Documentation](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/): Reference material for automating CDN20 platform operations.
- [API Authentication](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/authentication/): Authentication methods and credential usage for API access.
- [API Endpoints](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/endpoints/): Available API resources and endpoint organization.
- [Purge Cache API](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/purge-cache/): Programmatic cache invalidation and purge request details.
- [DNS API](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/dns/): API operations for managing DNS zones and records.
- [Security API](https://docs.cdn20.com/api/security/): API support for security configuration and policy management.

## Guides
- [Create a Pull Zone](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/create-a-pull-zone/): Steps for creating and configuring a pull-based CDN zone.
- [Configure Custom SSL](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/configure-custom-ssl/): Instructions for uploading and enabling custom certificates.
- [Set Up DNS](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/set-up-dns/): Guide to configuring domains and DNS records with CDN20.
- [Enable WAF](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/enable-waf/): How to activate and tune web application firewall protections.
- [Cache Configuration](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/cache-configuration/): Configure caching rules, TTLs, and content behavior.
- [Origin Configuration](https://docs.cdn20.com/guides/origin-configuration/): Define origin servers and delivery settings for edge traffic.
